title: Improving microalgae harvesting efficiency: electrochemical techniques and parameter optimization
content:
Environ. Sci.: Water Res. Technol., 2025, Advance Article
DOI: 10.1039/D5EW00518C, Paper
Open Access

Elif Yakamercan, Samriti Guleria, Mahmoud Karimi, Ahmet Aygun, Aparajita Bhasin, Halis Simsek
Electrochemical algae harvesting achieved 99% efficiency with BDD–Al electrodes. Lipid, protein, and sugar contents were assessed, while current, pH, and electrolysis time significantly influenced efficiency and energy use.
